CreateBlockingPolicy.description_zh: 为指定 IPv4 地址或域名创建封禁任务

CreateIdcTraction.description_en: Creates access configurations for up to 100 specified public assets. You can locate assets by asset ID list or public IP list. If both are provided, asset IDs take priority
CreateIdcTraction.description_zh: 为最多 100 个指定公网资产创建接入配置。可使用资产 ID 列表或公网 IP 列表定位资产；同时提供时优先使用资产 ID

CreateIdcTractionForAllAsset.description_en: Creates access configurations in batches for public assets that have not been accessed under the current account. When WithAutoAccess is set to true, automatic access is also enabled so that new assets are automatically accessed based on the configurations
CreateIdcTractionForAllAsset.description_zh: 为当前账号下尚未接入的公网资产批量创建接入配置。WithAutoAccess 取值为 true 时，同时开启自动接入，使后续新增资产按配置接入

CreatePrivateTraction.description_en: Creates a private traffic mirroring configuration for a specified VPC and selects the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) to connect. The operation is asynchronous and returns a task ID
CreatePrivateTraction.description_zh: 为指定 VPC 创建私网引流配置，并选择要接入的弹性网卡。接口异步执行，返回任务 ID

CreatePrivateTractionFilterRule.description_en: Creates a private network traffic mirroring filter rule. You can configure both inbound and outbound sub-rules at the same time
CreatePrivateTractionFilterRule.description_zh: 创建一条私网引流过滤规则，可同时配置入方向和出方向子规则

CreatePrivateTractionFilterSubRule.description_en: Creates an inbound or outbound sub-rule in a specified filter rule
CreatePrivateTractionFilterSubRule.description_zh: 在指定过滤规则中创建一条入方向或出方向子规则

DeleteBlockingPolicy.description_en: Synchronously deletes inactive blocking policies for specified entities
DeleteBlockingPolicy.description_zh: 同步删除指定实体的未生效封禁策略

DeleteIdcAssetTraction.description_en: Cancels the access configuration of specified public assets. You can locate assets by asset ID list or public IP list. If both are provided, asset IDs take precedence
DeleteIdcAssetTraction.description_zh: 取消指定公网资产的接入配置。可使用资产 ID 列表或公网 IP 列表定位资产；同时提供时优先使用资产 ID

DeletePrivateTraction.description_en: Disables private network traffic mirroring for a specified VPC. The operation is asynchronous and returns a task ID
DeletePrivateTraction.description_zh: 关闭指定 VPC 的私网引流。接口异步执行，返回任务 ID

DeletePrivateTractionFilterRule.description_en: Deletes a specified private network traffic mirroring filter rule. Before deleting, ensure that the rule is not used by any traffic mirror session
DeletePrivateTractionFilterRule.description_zh: 删除指定的私网引流过滤规则。删除前请确保该规则未被镜像会话使用

DeletePrivateTractionFilterSubRule.description_en: Deletes a sub-rule from a specified filtering rule
DeletePrivateTractionFilterSubRule.description_zh: 从指定过滤规则中删除一条子规则

DescribeAlertAggAnaIpItemGroupWithIncide.description_en: Queries statistics of alerting records associated with a specified event, grouped by rule, attack categorization, or member accounts
DescribeAlertAggAnaIpItemGroupWithIncide.description_zh: 按规则、攻击分类或成员账号分组统计指定事件的关联告警

DescribeAlertAggAnaIpItemWithEntity.description_en: Queries aggregated alert records for a specified entity within a given time range by paging. Records are grouped by rule, attacker IP address, victim IP address, network type, and network instances of both parties
DescribeAlertAggAnaIpItemWithEntity.description_zh: 分页查询指定实体在给定时间范围内的告警聚合记录。记录按规则、攻击者 IP、受害者 IP、网络类型及双方网络实例分组

DescribeAlertAggAnaIpItemWithIncident.description_en: Queries alert aggregation records for a specified event by paging. You can filter records by topology edge, rule, IP address, domain name, risk level, and other conditions. Records are grouped by rule, attacker IP address, victim IP address, network type, and network instances of both parties
DescribeAlertAggAnaIpItemWithIncident.description_zh: 分页查询指定事件的告警聚合记录，可按拓扑连线、规则、IP、域名、风险等级等条件筛选。记录按规则、攻击者 IP、受害者 IP、网络类型及双方网络实例分组

DescribeAlertLogs.description_en: Queries raw alert records within a specified time range for a given rule by paging, including attacker and victim information and traffic address details
DescribeAlertLogs.description_zh: 分页查询指定规则在时间范围内的原始告警及攻击双方、流量地址信息

DescribeBlockingPolicies.description_en: Queries blocking policies retained by the current account with paging, including their effective status, expire time, and node statistics
DescribeBlockingPolicies.description_zh: 分页查询当前账号保留的封禁策略及生效状态、过期时间和任务统计

DescribeBlockingRecords.description_zh: 分页查询封禁、解封及策略修改、删除的任务记录和执行结果

DescribeBlockingStatus.description_en: Queries whether the blocking feature has data anomalies or disabled associated policies
DescribeBlockingStatus.description_zh: 查询封禁功能关联策略是否存在数据异常或被关闭的情况

DescribeBlockingTaskStatus.description_en: Queries the execute status and failed types of blocking-related tasks by task UUID with paging
DescribeBlockingTaskStatus.description_zh: 按任务 UUID 分页查询封禁相关任务的执行状态和失败类型

DescribeIdcAssetAutoTractionConfig.description_en: 查询公网资产自动接入配置
DescribeIdcAssetAutoTractionConfig.description_zh: 查询自动接入总开关及各地域、各资源类型的启用状态

DescribeIncidentDisposalRecommendation.description_en: 查询实体推荐处置详情
DescribeIncidentDisposalRecommendation.description_zh: 查询指定实体的推荐处置状态、动作、摘要及详细报告

DescribeIncidentInvestigation.description_en: Queries the body, summary, conclusion status, and analysis time of a specified AI analysis report
DescribeIncidentInvestigation.description_zh: 查询指定 AI 分析报告的正文、摘要、结论状态和分析时间

DescribeIncidentTopologyGraph.description_en: Queries the entity nodes and attack associations of a specified security event
DescribeIncidentTopologyGraph.description_zh: 查询指定安全事件的实体节点及攻击关联关系

DescribePrivateAssetEnis.description_en: Queries elastic network interfaces (ENIs) and their associated instances, private IP addresses, and accessed states in a specified VPC by using paging
DescribePrivateAssetEnis.description_zh: 分页查询指定 VPC 下的弹性网卡及其关联实例、私网 IP 和接入状态

DescribePrivateAssets.description_en: Queries private network assets and their accessed states, network locations, and filtering rules in a specified VPC by using paging
DescribePrivateAssets.description_zh: 分页查询指定 VPC 下的私网资产及其接入状态、网络位置和过滤规则

DescribePrivateTraction.description_en: 获取私网引流配置详情
DescribePrivateTraction.description_zh: 查询指定 VPC 当前的私网引流配置、已用流量、带宽及执行时间

DescribePrivateTractionFilterRules.description_en: Queries private network traffic redirection filtering rules and their inbound and outbound sub-rules by paging
DescribePrivateTractionFilterRules.description_zh: 分页查询私网引流过滤规则及其入方向、出方向子规则

DescribePrivateTractionSupportZones.description_en: 获取私网引流支持的可用区
DescribePrivateTractionSupportZones.description_zh: 查询私网引流当前支持的地域和可用区

DescribePrivateTractionTaskDetail.description_en: 查询私网接入配置任务详情
DescribePrivateTractionTaskDetail.description_zh: 查询私网引流异步任务的状态、类型、执行步骤及资产处理结果

DisableBlocking.description_zh: 为指定实体批量创建解封任务，保留已有封禁策略

ListEntities.description_zh: 分页查询事件关联实体或全局实体，返回实体属性、关联统计和推荐处置摘要

ListIdcAsset.description_zh: 分页查询公网资产，可按资源类型、地域、接入状态、成员账号和关键字等条件筛选

ListIncidentInvestigations.description_en: 查询事件AI分析报告列表
ListIncidentInvestigations.description_zh: 分页查询指定事件的 AI 分析报告摘要、结论状态和分析时间，按报告生成时间倒序返回。完整正文请通过 DescribeIncidentInvestigation 查询

ListIncidents.description_zh: 分页查询安全事件，可按事件名称、ID、威胁等级、处理状态、AI 分析结果及关联实体筛选

ListRegion.description_en: Retrieves the list of regions supported by Network Detection and Response (NDR)
ListRegion.description_zh: 获取 NDR支持的地域列表

ModifyIdcAssetAutoTractionConfig.description_en: Modifies the automatic access configuration for resource types in a specified region. If no region is specified, the same configuration is applied to all regions
ModifyIdcAssetAutoTractionConfig.description_zh: 修改指定地域的自动接入资源类型配置；不指定地域时，将同一配置应用到所有地域

UpdateBlockingPolicy.description_en: Modifies the blocking direction, expiration time, or reason of an existing blocking policy. Calling this operation on an inactive policy activates the blocking
UpdateBlockingPolicy.description_zh: 修改已有策略的封禁方向、过期时间或原因；对未生效策略调用时会启用封禁

UpdateIncidentHandleStatus.description_en: Modifies the handling status of one or more security events
UpdateIncidentHandleStatus.description_zh: 修改一个或多个安全事件的处理状态

UpdatePrivateAssetFilterRule.description_en: 修改私网资产绑定的私网引流过滤规则
UpdatePrivateAssetFilterRule.description_zh: 修改指定私网资产使用的流量镜像过滤规则

UpdatePrivateTractionAssets.description_en: 修改指定 VPC 的引流资产
UpdatePrivateTractionAssets.description_zh: 为指定 VPC 增加或移除参与私网引流的弹性网卡。接口异步执行，返回任务 ID

UpdatePrivateTractionAttributes.description_en: Modifies the traffic limit and execution time configuration of a specified VPC
UpdatePrivateTractionAttributes.description_zh: 修改指定 VPC 的流量上限和执行时间配置

UpdatePrivateTractionFilterRuleAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a specified private network traffic mirroring filter rule
UpdatePrivateTractionFilterRuleAttribute.description_zh: 修改指定私网引流过滤规则的名称和描述

UpdatePrivateTractionFilterSubRule.description_en: 修改私网引流过滤子规则
UpdatePrivateTractionFilterSubRule.description_zh: 修改指定过滤子规则的优先级、动作、协议、网段和端口范围

UpdatePrivateTractionMaxBandwidth.description_en: 修改指定 VPC 的引流镜像带宽阈值
UpdatePrivateTractionMaxBandwidth.description_zh: 修改指定 VPC 的私网引流带宽。接口异步执行，返回任务 ID
